questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: The world record for staying awake the longest
Why listening to podcasts helps people fall asleep
An expert's advice for people who can't sleep
How many hours of sleep adults and children need
questions.why: They discuss insomnia and Dr Michael Grandner's best tip for getting to sleep.

options: He has had chronic insomnia for years
He was working on a project all night
He was reading trivia on his phone until 3am
He tossed and turned all night and couldn't sleep
questions.why: He says he was tossing and turning all night.

questions.q: What does Dr Grandner advise if you can't sleep?
options: Get out of bed
Stay in bed and close your eyes
Take sleeping pills
Drink some warm milk
questions.why: He says, 'If you cannot sleep, get out of bed.'

questions.q: Why does Dr Grandner say 'trust me' about his advice?
options: He has only just discovered it in a new study
It sounds wrong, but decades of data support it
He tried it himself last night and it worked well
Most other doctors strongly disagree with him
questions.why: He says it sounds counter-intuitive, but he has decades of data behind it.

questions.q: What happens if you often lie awake in bed, according to Dr Grandner?
options: Your body slowly gets used to having less sleep
You fall asleep much faster the next night
The bed's power to make you sleep gets weaker
You start to dream more and wake up tired
questions.why: He says 'the ability of the bed to put you to sleep starts getting diluted'.

questions.q: What starts to replace sleep in bed, according to Dr Grandner?
options: Reading books and watching TV shows
Thinking, tossing and turning, and worrying
Eating snacks and drinking hot drinks
Talking on the phone and checking emails
questions.why: He says it 'starts getting replaced by thinking, and tossing and turning, and worrying'.

questions.q: How effective does Dr Grandner say his advice is?
options: It doesn't always work, but works more than you'd think
It works every time, for every single patient
It only works for children and young teenagers
It rarely works, so sleeping pills are usually better
questions.why: He says it won't work 100% of the time, but more than most people think.

questions.q: What does Neil do when he can't sleep?
options: Listens to podcasts
Goes for a walk
Watches TV
Gets up and reads trivia
questions.why: He says, 'when I can't sleep, I get up and read trivia!'
